text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Superstar Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Waaaahh! Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: At last—

text_block_list.name: Seeking The Pearl
text_block_list.text: —Fufu, brilliant.
Indisputable watershed moment in Japanese racing—no, worldwide umamusume history.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
She won! She won!
Our Cesario-san did it...!
Yes, magnificent victory!
Yes, magnificent victory!
Crowd erupted in joy. Domestic fans back home surely doing same—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
She did iiiiiit! Cesario won...!
Everyone, Cesario did it...!

text_block_list.name: Antenna-haired Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: Incredible~. Pure chills~!

text_block_list.name: Single Knot Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: So cool! Wish I saw live!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(I did it...
Finally... reached it, didn't I? With these legs.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Following senpais' legacy... feat rivaling Kraft's—right here.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Now stand tall with pride. Fulfilled my mission. And—)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Become guiding beacon for future generations.)

text_block_list.name: 3rd Place Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: <If I race there, can I run like that too? Someday, I will...>

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: To all in America. And fans worldwide watching, thank you deeply. —I am Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Claiming G1 triumph on American turf marks first for my homeland. Everyone carries dream to fulfill...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Today, fulfilled mine. For those preparing to spread wings... proud to leave trail for future.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much.
Thank you for everything.
(Oooooooooh―...)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
<What a wonderful Uma Musume.
Not only is she fast, she's also polite.>

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: <Yes, she has a heart as broad as the sea.>

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it seems they are praising her quite a bit.
On top of that――

text_block_list.name: Interview Translator
text_block_list.text: Just two races ago, an amazing Uma Musume like you was unable to win. Why was that?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, the Uma Musume who won that time, Rhein Kraft... is faster than me. Especially when it comes to miles.
(Oooooooooooooh!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeh?! Why does it feel like she's introducing me~?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: <Rhein Kraft... An Uma Musume said to be faster than Cesario...?>

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: <Rhein Kraft... just how fast are you?>
Because of Cesario's remarks, it seemed the Oka Sho winner, Rhein Kraft, was about to draw even more attention.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... But really, congratulations, Cesario. You're amazing... It's like you're already a legend...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh...? But, it looks like...
After her victory, Cesario wore a contented smile on her face. That single scene would become part of history――
And be forever etched into our memories. A story that we would remember and pass down through the ages.
And be forever etched into our memories. A story that we would remember and pass down through the ages.
